knownSourceIssues.description: Dimension variables Icon/Thin and Icon/Thick both expose the same WEB code syntax --vet45-v2-icon-stroke while values differ (1 and 2). HTML DS preserves both values with distinct aliases and records the conflict instead of guessing which should own the canonical name.
Source component is named “DS v2 / Avata Card” and variants include “Defualt”/“Disable”. Traceability keeps source names while HTML API uses normalized data-state values.
